name: codex-workflow
description: A workflow skill collection for clarifying requirements, debugging, Figma/UI work, PRDs, technical specifications, approved implementation in a separate task, and safe subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Confirm documents, implement in a new task, and delegate safely when needed.
interface.longDescription: Codex Workflow is a local skill collection for requirements discovery, bug-report-based debugging, Figma and screenshot-driven UI work, and PRD and technical-specification writing. It selects an appropriate model and reasoning effort for approved implementation in a separate Codex task, and safely delegates only necessary subagent work with clear file ownership. It also includes safety rules for Git, PRs, commits, and technical writing.
defaultPrompt: Clarify these requirements and write a PRD.
Turn this idea into a PRD.
Read the approved PRD and write a technical specification.
Read this UI material and map the screen flow.
I will review the technical specification and approve implementation in a separate message.
Use $orchestrate-subagents to delegate only necessary subagent work and integrate the results.
